pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.
   C. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.
   D. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   B. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   C. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Physical has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.

7. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   B. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

12. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.
   B. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Church as a By the end of the Sub strand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain My 1.0 Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Creation of Plants and Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
